answer: The walnut debit happens at intake, vault totals the burned amount, and ivory anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 9 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm therefore pays the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Each copy needs 8 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
